question: Should the z supervision term compare the complete lifted vector z (which includes x) or only the hidden coordinates psi?
recommendation: Use the complete z vector, because the theory defines the one-step residual in the full lifted space and the user requirement is x plus z; explicitly state that this gives x overlapping weight.
impact: Complete z aligns training with A3 residual semantics; psi-only would define a different objective and require separate notation.
boundary: After this, ask separately about lambda weights/normalization and target-branch gradient flow.
